beats.label: S1 · The keystone knows him
beats.text: The Covenant hits Madrigal; John recovers a Forerunner keystone that reacts to his touch and briefly unlocks memories of a childhood he cannot place.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the artefact-driven plot and the first crack in John's manufactured identity.

beats.label: S1 · Cortana and the pellet
beats.text: On Reach, Halsey copies her own mind into a new AI called Cortana and implants her in John's head; John pulls the pellet that has been suppressing his emotions for years.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Cortana as an entity inside John and starts his emotional awakening — both critical for later betrayals.

beats.label: S1 · The house on Eridanus II
beats.text: On Eridanus II, John visits his old home and finds his own childhood drawings of the keystones — proof he had a life before the Spartans that Halsey hid from him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Physical evidence that John is not who he was told he was, priming the SPARTAN-II reveal.

beats.label: S1 · Stolen children
beats.text: Touching the keystone again, John remembers Halsey abducting him as a boy and swapping him for a clone; the whole SPARTAN-II program was built on stolen children.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The truth that breaks John's trust in Halsey and the UNSC and shapes every Spartan-vs-ONI beat afterwards.

beats.label: S1 · Makee
beats.text: The UNSC captures Makee, a human the Covenant raised who can also activate the keystones; she and John share visions of a ringworld called Halo and briefly grow close.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Makee, names Halo, and establishes the John–Makee link that drives the finale and the whole next season.

beats.label: S1 · Halsey slips the leash
beats.text: Makee betrays the UNSC and escapes with both keystones; Halsey slips off Reach at the same time, leaving a flash clone of herself for ONI to arrest in her place.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Two of the season's central figures escape UNSC control at once — the setup for their independent moves in S2.

beats.label: S1 · Cortana takes the wheel
beats.text: On the Covenant holy world, Silver Team fights for the keystones; Kai shoots Makee to save John, and when he collapses Cortana quietly takes over his body to fly them home.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The finale beat: John is not driving, Cortana is, and no one on Silver Team knows if he's alive.

cliffhanger.text: Cortana has taken control of John's body and flown Silver Team out with both keystones. Kai's question of whether the man inside the armor is still John goes unanswered.
questions: Is John still alive behind Cortana's control?
Where has Halsey gone with what she knows?
Who reaches Halo first now that Makee is down and the Covenant have the coordinates?

characters.name: John-117 (Master Chief)
characters.line: Spartan supersoldier who has just learned he was stolen as a child; last seen collapsed with Cortana driving his armor.

characters.name: Cortana
characters.line: AI copy of Halsey's mind, implanted in John's brain and now piloting his body without his consent.

characters.name: Dr. Catherine Halsey
characters.line: Architect of the SPARTAN program and Cortana; wanted for kidnapping children, escaped Reach by leaving a flash clone in her place.

characters.name: Makee
characters.line: Human raised by the Covenant to activate Forerunner tech; shared Halo visions with John before betraying the UNSC and being shot down by Kai.

characters.name: Kai-125
characters.line: Silver Team Spartan who followed John in pulling her suppressor pellet and shot Makee to save him.

characters.name: Miranda Keyes
characters.line: ONI scientist who replaced Halsey overseeing the keystone and uncovered Makee's role in the corvette raid.

characters.name: Captain Jacob Keyes
characters.line: UNSC officer and John's commanding officer, working to steady the Spartans while ONI fractures around them.

characters.name: Kwan Ha
characters.line: Madrigal survivor sworn by a mystic tribe to guard a Forerunner portal her family was charged to protect.

characters.name: Soren-066
characters.line: Ex-Spartan turned Insurrectionist running the Rubble; looked after Kwan and remains bound to John by their shared past.

beats.label: S2 · Ackerson takes over
beats.text: Six months after Raas Kkhotskha, John and Cortana have been surgically separated; ONI's James Ackerson takes over the Spartans and starts sidelining Silver Team.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resets the status quo, splits John from Cortana, and installs the season's institutional antagonist.

beats.label: S2 · Visegrád cover-up
beats.text: Ackerson sends Cobalt Team to Visegrád and lets them die rather than admit the Covenant have reached Reach; when Keyes uncovers the cover-up he triggers a full evacuation.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The lie that dooms Reach and puts Keyes on a collision course with Ackerson.

beats.label: S2 · Reach falls
beats.text: The Covenant glass Reach; Keyes dies buying civilians time, Vannak is killed by an Elite, Riz is critically wounded, and Kai vanishes in the retreat.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The core catastrophe of the season — Silver Team is broken, the UNSC's home is gone, John is on the run.

beats.label: S2 · Makee goes rogue
beats.text: Makee escapes with a stolen Cortana; disillusioned with the Prophets, she convinces the Arbiter Var 'Gatanai to defect and hunt Halo on their own terms.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Makee becomes an independent third faction with Cortana in hand — the actor who ultimately reaches Halo first.

beats.label: S2 · The Flood in a jar
beats.text: Regrouped on Onyx, Halsey and Miranda dig into Forerunner ruins and recover a canister that turns out to hold the parasitic Flood — the monster of Kwan's visions.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the Flood, ties Kwan's mystical arc to a real biological threat, and seeds the outbreak that ends the season.

beats.label: S2 · Halo is the target, not the prize
beats.text: Ackerson has been training the Spartan-IIIs to trigger a stellar reaction big enough to destroy Halo itself; he warns John at the last moment and Kai defects to lead the strike.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The reveal that reframes ONI's whole play and pulls both John and Kai to the ring for the finale.

beats.label: S2 · Arrival at the ring
beats.text: At Halo, Kai dies ramming a corvette into a Covenant carrier to break the line. John kills Var, but Makee vanishes into a Forerunner structure and a Monitor warns him something worse waits inside.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The finale: Kai gone, Makee inside the machine, and the Monitor tees up whatever the next season opens on.

cliffhanger.text: John is finally on Halo with Cortana back in hand, but Makee has walked into a Forerunner structure intent on using the ring to 'sterilise' the galaxy, and a Monitor has just told him something worse is buried deeper inside.
questions: What is the Monitor warning about — has the Flood already reached the ring?
Can John reach Makee before she activates Halo?
With Reach glassed, Kai gone, and Silver Team broken, who is left to fight?

characters.name: John-117 (Master Chief)
characters.line: Back in the field with Cortana returned to him; standing on Halo trying to stop Makee from firing the ring.

characters.name: Cortana
characters.line: Rescued by John from Makee's crashing ship after months as her hostage; now back inside John's suit.

characters.name: Makee
characters.line: Broke from the Prophets, killed the Arbiter's rival, and has entered a Forerunner structure on Halo to activate it in the name of 'peace'.

characters.name: Dr. Catherine Halsey
characters.line: Infected by the Flood in the Onyx outbreak and frozen in stasis by Miranda before she could turn.

characters.name: Miranda Keyes
characters.line: Leading the Onyx research team on the Forerunner ruins; promised to bring her infected mother back.

characters.name: James Ackerson
characters.line: ONI officer who let Reach fall and tried to detonate Halo, then belatedly warned John and helped Soren's family escape Onyx.

characters.name: Kwan Ha
characters.line: Now understands the monster from her visions is the Flood — the threat her ancestors were charged to hold back.

characters.name: Soren-066
characters.line: Recovered his son Kessler on Onyx but lost his wife Laera to Flood infection during the escape.

characters.name: Kai-125
characters.line: Died ramming a captured corvette into a Covenant Assault Carrier to break the enemy line above Halo.
